name: Required CLI --native-attempt-name, lowercase alphanumeric/hyphen 1..64; no default/PID fallback. Exclusive directory+owner; never reattach or reuse.
owner: planned host/boot binding explicitly unverified before queries
verification: Owned no-force query recorder first verifies exact current parent PID/start/argv and host/boot, then writes verification receipt. Host native mutation requires this receipt AND existing enabled flags, current shared session, plan/source/role guards.
query_commands: Fixed ps/lsof/sysctl/sw_vers/launchctl print and exact existing read-only list_handles subprocess only; no mutation in query dispatcher.
mutating_commands: Fixed debug/bootstrap/held-only bootout only. One invocation directory under transaction/native-commands/<attempt name>, owner binds verified observation attempt and exact active execution session. No generic command method.
records: Exclusive per-command intent, direct-Popen-created, natural-exit or unresolved; stdout/stderr redirected to retained owned files for captured commands. No implicit context wait/kill/terminate/retry.
timeouts: Existing20s query/bootstrap/bootout and180s Terminaldebug preserved. Failure retains intent, exact PID/argv if available, known natural reap vs unresolved; inability to publish created never means no child.
wiring: production_entrypoint check/inspect/fresh/resume all take explicit attempt name. Legacy preflight/inspector CLIs delegate same query attempt constructor. ProductionHost gets injected verified query IO; defaults refuse native spawn without a bound recorder.
recovery: Any incomplete native mutation attempt is a separate blocking uncertainty; do not use appearance of a holder to erase it or auto-rearm. Exact-phase core unchanged.
tests: Focused inert Popen/file/clock fakes only; test timeout/interruption/publication failure no signals/no retry, fixed grammar, query-vs-effect split, explicit attempt reservation and identity verification. Tests unrun.
